records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom remains the approved nameplate. Surname and given-name calls in these scenes use their established separate substitutions.
Julio Erneco remains the caption for the crew member who first notices the church figurehead and asks the priest about it.
Emilio Ferog remains the established label when his quiet breathing answers Hodram's question. Emilio is the form Hodram uses in the exchange.
Gerhard Adernkatz is the established officer's label in the conversations about the Proofs, the pirate hunt and the cave.
Charles Rochefort is the established officer's nameplate. The cave shortcut is his suggestion.
Samwell Khan is the established short nameplate. In the bear encounter his warning is separate from the crew style variants.
Julian Vermeer is the established spelling in the assignment and on the captured man's nameplate. The separate courier role belongs to his story.
Plett Perrault is the established name in the bounty and the captive's response. Keep the same spelling in both.
Jean Ramusio is the name the guildmaster gives and the established caption when Jean defends himself.
Gabriel Cardocci appears by the same full name at the tavern and when Hodram returns him to the guild.
Jacob Portunto matches the guildmaster's wanted man. The cargo complaint supplies character voice.
William Clive is the established captive's nameplate. The guildmaster identifies him as William in speech.
Hernan Berio is the established name in the assignment and his pompous demand for passage.
Barkeep is a familiar label for the person demanding Gabriel settle his tab.
Port Worker is the shared role for the messenger from the Stockholm guild. The scene supplies no personal name.
Port Worker is the same role for the man passing on the Sao Jorge guild's message.
Port Worker is the same role for the Havana messenger. He asks the captain's surname before giving the news.
Guard is the established court role for the speaker announcing the summons and welcoming the admiral back.
King is the established caption for the Swedish ruler. Your Majesty is Hodram's spoken address.
Priest remains the contextual label for the keeper of the church figurehead. The two revised lines describe its history and return.
Guildmaster is the established role for the official handling Gabriel, Julian and William.
Guildmaster is the established role for the official who commissions the bounty and pays the rewards for Jean, Jacob and Hernan.
Guildmaster is the established role for the official who asks for help with Plett and defers to the woman who brought the case.
Sailor is the shared role for the crew member reporting what Gabriel hid and for the attendees in the later alerts.
Villager is the established role for the man asking for help finding his ancestors' ruins. The conversation supplies his perspective and no personal name.
